definitions.gloss: dressing in a kimono; kimono dressing
definitions.explanation: Putting on a kimono correctly, with its under-layers and obi, or dressing someone else in one. It takes skill, and many people have it done by a professional for weddings, coming-of-age ceremonies, and other formal occasions.

examples.japanese: {着付|きつ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: To learn how to put on a kimono.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{朝早|あさはや}く⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{着付|きつ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: On the day of the coming-of-age ceremony, I had my kimono put on at a hair salon early in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着付|きつ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧なら⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着|き}られる→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother taught kimono dressing, so I can at least put on a yukata by myself.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to wear) + ⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (fitting).
